entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. For questions about a new order, press 1. For returns or issues with an existing order, press 2.
Ugh, two.
Thank you for calling VeloFit, my name is Sam. How can I help you today?
Hi, I need to return an item. It's the VeloBand Pulse. My order number is VF-8675309.
I can certainly look into that for you. One moment... Okay, I see the order for the VeloBand Pulse, delivered about 15 days ago. Can you tell me why you're looking to return it?
It's just not for me. The heart rate tracking is inconsistent and the battery life is terrible. I've been using it for two weeks and I'm not happy with it.
I understand your disappointment. Just to confirm, the item has been opened and worn for the past two weeks, is that correct?
Yes, of course. How else would I know it doesn't work right?

I see. Unfortunately, according to VeloFit's return policy, we can only accept returns for items that are in new, unused, and unopened condition. Since the VeloBand Pulse has been used, I'm unable to process a return for a refund.
What? That's ridiculous! That's completely unacceptable. So I'm just supposed to be stuck with a product that doesn't work as advertised?
I do apologize for the frustration. The policy is in place for health and hygiene reasons, as we cannot resell wearable electronics once they've been used.
I don't care about your policy, I care about my money. This is a terrible way to do business. Let me speak to your boss.
I understand you're upset, but a manager would have to provide you with the same information. I am fully authorized to handle this situation for you.
No, you're clearly not handling it. Get your supervisor on the phone right now. I want to speak to a manager.
Okay. Please allow me to place you on a brief hold while I see if a supervisor is available.
Hello, my name is Maria, I'm a supervisor here at VeloFit. I understand you're having an issue with a return for your VeloBand Pulse?
Yes! Finally. Your agent told me I can't return this thing even though I've only had it for two weeks. This is an unacceptable policy.

I apologize for the difficult experience you're having. I've reviewed the notes and I do see that the item has been used. While our policy on used wearables is firm for safety reasons, I want to make sure I fully understand the issue. Could you tell me more about the inconsistencies you experienced?
I already explained! The heart rate monitor is junk and the battery dies in a day. I want my money back. I don't want to troubleshoot it, I want to return it.

I hear your frustration, and I am sorry that the product didn't meet your expectations. However, I do have to stand by our policy regarding used items. A refund is not possible in this case. What I can do, as a one-time courtesy, is offer you a 15% credit towards your next VeloFit purchase.
A coupon? You think I want to buy something else from you after this? This is unbelievable. Forget it. I'll just dispute the charge with my credit card company.
